_provenance.method: adb run-as + base64; raw leveldb files byte-verified into leveldb-2026-08-17/
notes: civic_2013_lifetime_stats_v2 lived in the Snappy-compressed compacted table 000013.ldb.

Its three persisted fields were recovered as plaintext fragments and verified: totalMiles/totalFuelGallons reproduces the stored lifetimeMpg with delta exactly 0, proving all three came from the same object.
telemetryManager only reads totalMiles, totalFuelGallons and firstTrackedTimestamp; lifetimeMpg is recomputed on load.
civic_2013_oil_profile_v1 is the last of 17 appended writes in the write-ahead log 000011.log.
civic.pidDiscovery.lastScan.v1 was not present in either file. It is regenerable by re-running a PID scan, so it is not a loss.
